props.gloss_en: the baraita's first tanna: a sandal one of whose ears or one of whose straps tore remains impure
R' Yehuda: if the inner [ear] tore it is impure; the outer -- pure
R' Yochanan: as the dispute concerning impurity, so the dispute concerning Shabbat
R' Yochanan: but not concerning chalitza
the mishna: if she removed the left [shoe] worn on the right foot, her chalitza is valid
[the horn:] R' Yochanan speaks per the Rabbanan -- as it is a vessel for impurity, so for Shabbat, but not for chalitza, for which it is not a vessel
R' Yochanan speaks per R' Yehuda -- as it is not a vessel for impurity, so it is not a vessel for Shabbat
read [R' Yochanan's memra]: and likewise concerning chalitza
when we say that left-on-right chalitza is valid, that is where it is a vessel for its own function; here it is not a vessel for its own function
R' Yochanan: the halakha follows an unattributed mishna
the mishna: a sandal one of whose ears tore and he repaired it is impure with midras
the mishna: [if] the second tore and he repaired it -- pure of midras impurity, but impure with contact of midras
no -- [the mishna speaks of] the inner [ear] specifically
Rav Yitzchak ben Yosef: let our mishna be a sandal that has four ears and four straps, so as not to break R' Yochanan's words
Rav: the halakha follows R' Yehuda [on the torn sandal]
R' Yochanan: the halakha does not follow R' Yehuda
the mishna: all householders' vessels -- their measure is pomegranates
Chizkiya, as R' Yochanan recalls him, on the sandal repaired twice: a new face has come here
a vessel holed the size of an olive and sealed, again and again until [the holes] completed a pomegranate: here too a new face has come here
he exclaimed about him: this is not a human being
some say [he exclaimed]: such a one is a human being
if the early ones are sons of angels, we are sons of men
and if the early ones are sons of men, we are like donkeys -- not like the donkey of R' Chanina ben Dosa or of R' Pinchas ben Yair, but like other donkeys

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והאמר רבי יוחנן הלכה כסתם משנה (p_ry_halakha_kestam_mishna), ותנן: סנדל שנפסקה אחת מאזניו ותיקנה טמא מדרס... מאי לאו לא שנא פנימית ולא שנא חיצונה! -- the unattributed mishna makes no distinction, against R' Yehuda

answered_by.gloss_en: תהא משנתנו בסנדל שיש לו ארבע אזנים וארבע תרסיותים, שלא לשבור דבריו של רבי יוחנן (= p_mishna_arba_oznayim)

objections.gloss_en: אבל חיצונה מאי -- טהור? אי הכי, אדתני נפסקה שניה ותיקנה..., ניפלוג בדידה: במה דברים אמורים שנפסקה פנימית, אבל חיצונה טהור! -- had the mishna meant the inner ear only, it would have drawn the distinction within the case itself
ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והא מדמתרץ רבי יוחנן אליבא דרבי יהודה, שמע מינה כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמוראי נינהו ואליבא דרבי יוחנן -- they are [different] amoraim [reporting] R' Yochanan's view
